newsitem.title: USA: Bank West Financial to repurchase shares.
newsitem.headline: Bank West Financial to repurchase shares.

text.p: Bank West Financial Corp said Monday that it intends to repurchase up to 198,000 shares, or about 10 percent of its outstanding common stock.
The repurchase of shares is subject to the prior approval of the Office of Thrift Supervision, which has not yet been received, the savings bank holding company said.

"We believe that the company's common stock continues to represent an attractive investment opportunity," Bank West President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Sydloski said in a statment. "The stock repurchase is expected to be accretive on a book value and earnings per share basis."
